mandatory_integration_boundaries: Before qualified_origin can be used, the actual consumer must verify the complete parsed input is HEADERS+view.text and call check_view. This is its explicit API precondition; this isolated helper does not attest AST/source provenance itself.

Generic pointer analysis must remain closed outside the exact admitted model function/context, preserve all offset/bounds/null/type checks and never grant this origin to an ordinary user caller or data-like field by name alone.

Any future admitted caller route needs independent actual source storage/lifetime/domain discharge; current module returns no such admission. No compiler/proof result is created or inferred by preparing a View.
source_and_domain_reasoning: The complete source must equal std_models.model_text for the pinned original2 parent before qualification. Non-at bodies are byte-identical; the original contract hash is separately bound and compared with the view contract.

at elides only the exact defensive n>=size failure branch and inserts an explicit at_guard_false assertion. The unchanged original n<size precondition makes that branch unreachable; no new ACSL input premise or payload surrogate is introduced.

The qualified domain is an original typed contiguous element array of capacity elements plus a live receiver/array throughout the nonallocating call. This is an explicit conditional body domain; actual callers must discharge it. Generic pointer validity is not converted into an array/ownership theorem.

Origin recognition is limited to end/at/operator_index and the exact this->data arrow field of the actual function this ParmVarDecl, with exact const vector receiver type and matching element-pointer type. Only NoOp/LValueToRValue/parentheses strip; explicit casts, wrong field, receiver identity or payload type do not gain an origin.

begin/data empty/null returns remain original and do not perform pointer arithmetic; end keeps its original null/zero-size guard. at/index keep original n<size requirements. clear only changes logical size, with no element loads/conversions. int,float,double,int-pointer values are not recast into integer or finite payload models.

Method selection requires the exact dedicated contract-fixture method and one current checker identity; stale/duplicate/missing qualification pins refuse. check_view reconstructs the entire view and domain after mutation.

check_record only validates exact current body/domain certificate fields; normal schema/current-method/setup/native/outcome validation remains an outer requirement. require_caller_discharge always refuses after that qualification, so a tagged body record cannot by this API become an unrestricted caller dependency.

reviewed_behavior: explicit method and stale/duplicate/missing pin refusal
qualified record cannot become generic caller dependency
